standards.wc:standard:ny-7r1: Cite textual evidence to support an analysis of what the text says explicitly/implicitly and make logical inferences. (RI&RL)

wc:expectation:cite-evidence-infer.action: Cite textual evidence and make logical inferences
wc:expectation:cite-evidence-infer.object: an analysis of what the text says explicitly/implicitly
qualifiers: The analysis includes what the text says explicitly/implicitly.
Applies to literary and informational text (RI&RL).
wc:expectation:cite-evidence-infer.parsing_rationale: Retains the coordinated tasks as one compound expectation, preserving the connection between evidence, analysis, and inference. RI&RL is interpreted using the page heading Literary and Informational Text. This is not an assessment rubric, prerequisite, or measurable mastery claim.
